days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Bosco della Mesola
stops.detail: It protects important areas such as the Bosco della Mesola, where a rare subspecies of red deer survives, the Valle Bertuzzi and the sacca di Goro.

stops.name: abbazia di Pomposa
stops.detail: It also includes the abbey of Pomposa, dating back to the 9th century.

days.title: Southern Marshes, Pines and Basilicas
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Punte Alberete
stops.detail: The most important area is the marshy complex of Punte Alberete and Valle Mandriole, where very rare species such as the glossy ibis, the spoonbill, the pygmy cormorant and the squacco heron nest, but the large Pineta di San Vitale and the Pialassa della Baiona lagoon are also significant.

stops.name: Pineta di Classe
stops.detail: It includes an uninterrupted natural complex from the sea to the hinterland, from the pristine mouth of the Bevano stream, to the marshes of Ortazzino and Ortazzo, to the Pineta di Classe; further south is the Salina di Cervia.

stops.name: basilica di Sant'Apollinare in Classe
stops.detail: The station also includes the archaeological excavations of the ancient port of Classe and the basilica of Sant'Apollinare in Classe.

stops.name: centro visite di Sant'Alberto
stops.detail: Among them, the Sant'Alberto visitor center is also a museum dedicated to birdlife.
